owner.name: Theo Marsh
owner.bio: Theo Marsh has been detailing cars around Boise since his first job cleaning up trade-ins for a used lot. Kestrel Detail Co. is the one-van operation he always wanted to run: he shows up to your driveway with water, power and everything else, does the work himself, and doesn't leave until the car looks like the day you fell for it. No lot to drop off at, no shuttle to catch, no upsell games — just an honest detail and a number you agreed to before he started.

zones.label: Paint & body
zones.blurb: A foam pre-soak lifts grit before a gentle two-bucket hand wash, then bug and tar spots come off by hand. Clay and a spray sealant leave the finish slick and beading — not just clean, protected.

zones.label: Glass & mirrors
zones.blurb: Inside and out, edge to edge, including the streaks everyone misses at the top of the windshield and the smudges on the mirrors. Ask for a rain-repellent treatment and we'll add it.

zones.label: Interior & seats
zones.blurb: Vacuumed down to the seat tracks, mats shampooed, leather cleaned and conditioned, plastics wiped down. Steam where it needs it — and no greasy shine left behind on the dash.

zones.label: Wheels & tires
zones.blurb: Barrels, faces and lug nuts scrubbed, brake dust and iron fallout dissolved, then a satin dressing on the tires. It's the first thing people notice and the first thing most washes skip.

zones.label: Trim & details
zones.blurb: Faded black trim brought back, door jambs wiped, vents and cupholders dug out, badges detailed. The small stuff that makes a whole car read as cared-for.

notes.pkgAddon: Bigger rig — truck, van, or a third-row SUV packed with life? Add $20–$40 depending on size. Not sure which package? Book "help me pick" and we'll sort it when we see the car.
notes.addonFoot: Something not on the list? Text us a photo and we'll tell you straight whether it's worth doing.
